stories.title: Chester Zoo to close early on Thursday due to extreme heat forecast
stories.summary: Chester Zoo will close early on Thursday in response to the extreme heat forecast tomorrow. The organisation confirmed on social media that it will close its doors to the public at 2pm (Thursday, 25 June) for the safety of its visitors and colleagues. stories.title: North Wales Police to get domestic abuse specialist in 999 control room under Raneem’s Law
stories.summary: Domestic abuse specialists are to be placed inside North Wales Police’s 999 control room under the second phase of a scheme set up after two women were murdered despite calling police for help. stories.title: Age Cymru urges Flintshire communities to check on older neighbours during extreme heat
stories.summary: Older people across Flintshire are being urged to take care during this week’s extreme heat, as Age Cymru calls on friends, family and neighbours to check in on those who may be struggling.
